messages.text: {crew}. Lou. I once said I never heard of y'all. Put that on the record as wrong.
Five regions. Five finalists. All five asked for you by name. Baltimore, this weekend.
Last game's on THE CROWN. Streaming coast to coast. Clean shoes. I check.
we'll be there
Rented a bus for Nationals. Working AC. Brand new tires. I kicked every one of them.
I kicked them too. and checked the oil. and the driver's license. twice
THE WHOLE COUNTRY WATCHING US 📺🔥 my aunt in Ohio texted me in ALL CAPS 😭
...Youngins. Look out the window. That sign says Baltimore.
1998, we never saw that sign. We finally got here. The bus made it.
now let's finish the trip
Told you. Philly's been waiting.
Ran the Funkquake every day since the East final. Twice on Sundays.
Nobody beats the Funk twice. You did. Nobody beats us three times.
first time for everything
Our bus got here a day early. We don't take chances anymore.
Funk's 31-0 since the East final. they printed our score on their warmup shirts
WE'RE ON THEIR SHIRTS?? that's basically merch 😭🔥
Philly remembers, youngin. So do we. Stand in the quake like last time.
PHILLY. THREE. TIMES. I'D TYPE IT THREE TIMES BUT MY THUMBS ARE SHAKING 😭
Funkquake hit in the 5th. nobody fell. first crew ever to stand in it three times
Maestro gave me his warmup shirt. Our score's on it. Framing it next to Dre's W.
Respect the ones that made you better, youngin. Philly made us.
one down. four to go
Third time's the Funk. Rest up, {crew}. Nationals ain't over.
the shirts were a mind game. it worked. I'm mad
run it back
Remember Cleveland? We remember you. All winter. Off the lake. In the wind.
Whole off-season in the CRUSH ZONE. Steel Mill Sully booted one into Lake Erie.
hope he got it back
He swam for it. In March. That's Cleveland. Saturday we swim through you.
Crush hit .420 in the Midwest playoffs. Sully alone has 9 deep boots
WE'VE CAUGHT DEEPER 🧤🧤
Pierogi Paula sent us a tray of pierogies. Respect or a trap. Eating them either way.
Never turn down food, youngin. Turn down the Crush Zone.
CRUSHED THE CRUSH 😂😂 been sitting on that one since the Midwest
Sully aimed for the lake again. no lake this time. just my hands
Paula wants her tray back. Told her it's coming back with a trophy on it.
Two down, youngins. Halfway there.
it's 40%, Pops. two of five
I know how to count, youngin.
Miami next
That's the Crush Zone, {crew}. Lake wind blows all the way to Baltimore.
outkicked by a man who swims in Lake Erie in March. honestly respect
run it back
Oye {crew}. It's 74 in Baltimore. That's sweater weather for us.
But the HEAT INDEX travels. You beat us in the South. We drove 17 hours on that.
hope you brought snacks
Cafecito Kid brought a thermos. Twelve shots. We don't sleep. We don't lose twice.
Heatwave steals 3 bases a game. Little Havana Lexi is 22 for 22
so we DON'T LET HER ON BASE 🧠💯
groundbreaking, Dre
Fast crews get impatient late, youngin. Be there in the seventh.
WE COOLED OFF MIAMI ❄️❄️ HEAT INDEX?? MORE LIKE HEAT INDEX CARD. FILED 🗂️
Lexi got caught stealing. first time in 23 tries. she asked to see the replay
The thermos ran dry in the 6th. You could watch it happen on their faces.
Three down. Don't look at THE CROWN yet, youngins. Two more.
two more
Too hot, {crew}? Have a cafecito. You'll need it for the rematch.
Bus has AC. Everybody get in, cool off. We go again.
again
We play a mile up. Baltimore's basically underwater. We're about to fly.
And the DUST DEVIL don't need dust. But we brought some. In a jar.
the jar is a choice
Fiesta Bea's idea. She brought green chile for after too. Winners eat.
Roadrunners steal home 1 in 4 tries. they try twice a game. that's math I hate
THE JAR GUYS?? beat 'em in the desert, we beat 'em at sea level 🌵🔥
Asked the hotel for lint rollers. For the dust. They said what dust. They'll learn.
Don't chase the wind, youngin. Wait for it to stop. It always stops.
THE DUST SETTLED AND IT WAS US 🌪️😭 US!!!
they opened the jar in the 6th. wind blew it right back at them. I have video
Diablo gave us the green chile anyway. Said winners eat. Then got a little teary.
HE SAID IT WAS DUST 😂
Four down. Tomorrow's THE CROWN, youngins.
All these years I walked past that gate. Tomorrow I walk through it.
we walk in together
Dust Devil, {crew}. Shake it out your shoes and come back.
there's sand in my socks and my soul
run it back
West Coast final, you chopped us down. So we replanted.
Old Growth hasn't said a word since. He just kicks. Knocked over a tree. A small one.
bring the axe. we're bringing the whole block
When I yell TIMBER, something falls. Tomorrow it's {crew}. On THE CROWN.
Lou gave me the key for warmups. I am holding a KEY. To THE CROWN.
no numbers tonight. ok one. zero. crews from our block that won Nationals. till tomorrow
i can't even type in caps i'm too nervous. that's how you know it's real
Youngins. Walk in. Look at it. Now you've earned the look.
for the block
WE WON NATIONALS!!!!! ON THE CROWN!!!!! 👑👑👑👑👑
checked the scoreboard nine times. it keeps saying the same thing
Lou's trying to give a speech. Nobody can hear him. The whole court is screaming.
BIG TIMBER YELLED TIMBER AND HE'S THE ONE THAT FELL 🪓😂
POPS??
Give me a minute, youngin. I been waiting on this one since 1998.
take all the time you need
TIMBER. Sorry, {crew}. The Crown don't crown everybody.
Bus is still running, youngin. The court ain't going nowhere. Neither are we.
one more time

title.sub: NOBODY FROM OUR BLOCK. UNTIL US.

messages.text: {crew}. Lou. Twenty years of brackets. Never crowned a nobody.
Still haven't. Y'all stopped being nobody about four regions ago.
Your name goes on the wall at THE CROWN. Permanent paint. Spell it right.
you'll hear of us
Bus just pulled up on the block. Whole street's outside. Somebody's mom made a banner.
banner says KINGS OF THE COURT. spelled right. I checked twice
NOBODY from our block ever made Nationals. NOBODY. and we WON it 😭👑🔥
Youngins. '98, the bus broke down on the way. I told that story every summer since.
Got a new one now. It's short. We won.
first Pops story under eleven minutes. historic night all around
POPS IS CRYING
It's pollen.
Youngin. Just you. Real talk.
It wasn't pollen.
Proud of you. Get some sleep. Kings still gotta take out the trash Tuesday.
say less
